title: Complete Node.js Bootcamp
description: Master Node.js from the ground up. This course covers Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, REST APIs, authentication with JWT, file uploads with Multer, email sending, Stripe payments, and deployment. Based on real-world production patterns used by senior developers.
summary: Go from zero to production-ready Node.js developer in one course.
whatYouLearn: Build fast, scalable REST APIs with Node.js and Express
Work with MongoDB and Mongoose for data modeling
Implement JWT authentication with access and refresh tokens
Handle file uploads and process images
Send transactional emails with Nodemailer
Integrate Stripe for real payment processing
Deploy your app to production

title: React & Tailwind CSS Masterclass
description: Build beautiful, responsive web applications with React 18 and Tailwind CSS. Learn component architecture, hooks, state management with Zustand, React Router, and how to style everything with utility-first CSS. Includes three complete portfolio projects.
summary: Build stunning UIs with React and Tailwind CSS — beginner to advanced.
whatYouLearn: Build production-grade React applications from scratch
Master React hooks — useState, useEffect, useContext, useReducer
Style efficiently with Tailwind CSS utility classes
Manage global state with Zustand
Implement client-side routing with React Router v6
Build and deploy three complete portfolio projects

title: Python for Data Science & Machine Learning
description: Learn Python for data analysis, visualization, and machine learning. This course covers NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn, and an introduction to deep learning with TensorFlow. Hands-on with real datasets throughout.
summary: From Python basics to machine learning models — one complete course.
whatYouLearn: Write Python from scratch — variables, loops, functions, OOP
Manipulate data with NumPy and Pandas
Visualize insights with Matplotlib and Seaborn
Build and evaluate ML models with Scikit-learn
Introduction to neural networks with TensorFlow

title: React Native Mobile Development
description: Build iOS and Android apps with React Native and Expo. This course takes you from setting up your development environment to publishing apps on the App Store and Google Play. Covers navigation, animations, camera, push notifications, and AsyncStorage.
summary: Ship mobile apps for iOS and Android using your React skills.
requirements: A smartphone for testing (or use the simulator)
whatYouLearn: Build cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo
Implement navigation with React Navigation v6
Style with StyleSheet and NativeWind (Tailwind for RN)
Access native device features — camera, location, notifications
Manage offline data with AsyncStorage
Publish your app to App Store and Google Play
